records.title: Evidence-Based Approach to the Analysis of Serious Decompression Sickness with Application to EVA Astronauts
records.locator: Appendix C, printed pp. 40–46 (PDF pp. 46–52), and Appendix A, printed pp. 31–36
records.extraction_method: All six rendered Appendix C pages visually transcribed and reconciled to the paper abstract and Tables II and VI.
records.evidence_note: Historical synthesis of 73 cited sources. Appendix C lists source-defined serious DCS by grouped test and labels the denominators male subjects. The report describes their total as altitude exposures, with no unique participant linkage. The modeled cumulative-risk column was omitted. All rows are on overlap hold.
